name: Marianna
description: Marianna is a fast-paced Italian partnership card game, widely considered a strategic evolution of Briscola. Played by four players in two fixed teams, it is unique because the 'Trump' suit is not predetermined by the dealer. Instead, the first team to declare a 'Marianna' (a King and Knight of the same suit) simultaneously scores bonus points and chooses the trump suit for the remainder of the round. This dynamic makes the start of every hand a high-speed race to find and declare a marriage.

Played by four players in two fixed teams, it is unique because the 'Trump' suit is not predetermined by the dealer. history.origins: Emerging in Sicily and Southern Italy as a variation of the French/Spanish 'Mariage' games, it was refined into a 4-player team game in the early 20th century.
timeline: 1910s: Becomes the most popular competitive card game in Sicilian social clubs (Circoli).
1950s: Rules for 'Cinquecento' (500) and partnership 'Accuse' are standardized.
Present: A cultural staple of Southern Italy, frequently played in bars and piazzas.
2004: Digitized for online card game platforms specializing in Italian regional games.
history.cultural: In Sicily, declaring a Marianna is often called 'Cantare' (to sing).
history.evolution: The game's 'shifting trump' mechanic (where the trump suit can change if a SECOND Marianna is declared) is a rare feature in trick-taking history.

setup.players: 4 players in fixed partnerships (North-South vs East-West).
setup.deck: 40 cards. Ranking: Ace, 3, King, Knight, Jack, 7, 6, 5, 4, 2.
setup.dealing: Each player receives 5 cards at a time. No card is turned for trumps.

rules.objective: Score 501 points through tricks and 'Marianna' bonuses.
rules.gameplay:
1. No obligation to follow suit initially.
2. After each trick, players draw 1 card from the stock to stay at 5 cards.
3. Once the stock is empty, players must follow suit (in some variations).
4. The highest card of the suit led wins, unless someone trumps it.
keyRules: No obligation to follow suit; play any card. Trick won by highest of led suit, or highest trump if any trumps played.
After each trick, winner draws first then each player in order so everyone has five cards again. Winner leads next trick.
Declare marianna (king and queen of same suit) at your turn to score bonus and set or change trump. First 40, second 60, third 80, fourth 100 points.
After the last card is drawn from the stock, no more mariannas; last five tricks played from hand without drawing.

strategy.basic: Race for the first Marianna. Since it sets the trump, being the first to declare is a massive advantage. If you have a King and Knight, declare it immediately, even if it's your first card.
strategy.intermediate: The Trump Switch: If your opponents declared the first Marianna (setting trumps to Hearts), and you have a Marianna in Diamonds, wait until they've led their high Hearts before you declare YOUR Marianna. This switches the trump suit and renders their high Hearts useless.
strategy.advanced: Draw-Deck Management: Since you draw a card after every trick, you have 5-10 draws to complete a Marianna. If you have only a King, keep it! The probability of drawing its Knight is about 1 in 8 for each draw.
tips: Track the 'Points of the Table': Ace and 3 are 21 points combined. Don't play them until the trump suit is firmly established by your team.
In the 'Cinquecento' (500 pt) variant, remember that speed is everythingâ€”the bonus points for Mariannas are the fastest way to 501.

variations.name: Declaration at start of trick
variations.description: Marianne may be declared before any card is led; the player leading to the trick pauses to allow declarations. Once a card is led, no more declarations until next trick.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant affects timing only; no engine constants to override.

variations.name: Lower marianna scores
variations.description: First marianna 20, second 40, third 60, fourth 80 points instead of 40, 60, 80, 100.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Scoring values not yet mapped to engine constants.

variations.name: First marianna sets trump only
variations.description: Later marianna declarations score points but do not change the trump suit.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Trump-change rule not yet expressed as engine overrides.

scoring.description: Each team keeps a cumulative score. At end of play, count card points in tricks (120 total in pack) plus marianna bonuses; first team to 501 or more wins.
scoring.winCondition: First team to reach 501 or more points wins the game.
